name: ReXrank
description: ReXrank is a public leaderboard and challenge for evaluating AI-powered radiology report generation, incorporating a large test dataset and multiple public datasets, with 8 evaluation metrics to assess model performance on generating findings and impressions sections.
reputation: A recent public radiology-report generation leaderboard that is starting to be used for comparative evaluation in medical imaging NLP.
notes: Includes ReXGradient dataset with 10,000 studies and evaluates robustness across diverse clinical settings.
